BREAKING: More than $350 million in crypto assets has been drained from wallets belonging to cryptocurrency exchange Bitget in a confirmed hack, according CEO Gracy Chen.

Bitget says ~$351.6 million was drained from some of its hot wallets and that its cold wallets remain secure.

The exchange also said user funds are safe and the full loss is covered by its "User Protection Fund," which holds ~$464 million for incidents like these.
